title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
The Lead Software Engineer for Disney Experiences Technology is a subject matter expert and hands-on technical leader who designs, builds, and evolves high-scale software that powers magical, immersive Guest experiences across parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints worldwide. In this role, you guide engineering efforts across the stack, mentor other developers, and ensure solutions are robust, performant, and aligned with Disney’s creative, customer-focused, and innovative culture.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you act as a skilled, experienced subject matter expert and lead, organizing development efforts across UI, services, and integrations to deliver intuitive, high-volume Guest and internal experiences for Disney Experiences brands. You solve complex problems, identify innovative solutions, and serve as a mentor and problem-solver who can explain difficult concepts, influence technical direction, and collaborate as a team player across technology and business partners. This role matters because it connects engineering excellence with Disney’s Guest-centric vision, requiring strong technical depth, communication, collaboration, and accountability to succeed.

* Serve as a subject matter expert and technical lead across the software stack, guiding architecture, design, and implementation for complex, large-scale systems and applications.

* Organize and lead development efforts, including analysis, programming, debugging, and modification of software improvements and new products used across Guest-facing and internal platforms.

* Mentor, train, and guide individual contributors by providing continuous coaching, feedback, and technical oversight, helping them connect their work to team goals and business outcomes.

* Break down organizational and product goals into clear strategies, expectations, and priorities, empowering team members to contribute their unique talents toward well-defined results.

* Lead end-to-end troubleshooting, problem analysis, and incident resolution for high-volume, 24/7 applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and a seamless Guest experience.

* Participate in and often lead agile rituals—such as scrums, sprint planning, capacity tracking, and demos—to align deliverables, manage dependencies, and drive continuous value delivery.

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and other technology teams to define system requirements, estimate and plan scalable projects, and negotiate solutions that balance technical and business needs.

* Own the design and development of backend services, APIs, and integrations, including security, data flow, and performance considerations for cloud-hosted, distributed systems.

* Stay current with emerging technologies and tools, making informed recommendations that foster creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team.

* Create an environment where Disney values are experienced daily by encouraging collaboration, creative problem solving, accountability, and ensuring every voice is heard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong subject matter expertise in software engineering, with the ability to lead complex projects and act as a primary technical point of contact for teams and stakeholders.

* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, Python, or similar, including experience with front-end and service development for high-volume applications.

* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, including security frameworks like OAuth and JWT and integration with cloud hosting environments.

* Familiarity with persistent storage technologies such as relational databases, document databases, caches, and database programming (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, schema design).

* Comfort working in an agile environment, managing team rituals, coordinating releases, and delivering continuous value across large or sophisticated systems.

* Strong problem-solving, analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts, negotiate different points of view, and influence technical direction.

* Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers, hold self and others accountable to commitments, and collaborate effectively as a team-oriented, customer-focused leader.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience.

* Minimum 7 years of industry experience in software development or related work on large, scalable systems and high-scale environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience operating at scale in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP), including observability, performance monitoring, and reliability for 24/7 web applications.

* Background with server-side rendering web frameworks (such as Astro or Angular SSR) to ensure performant, accessible, and SEO-optimized experiences for Disney Parks websites.

* Exposure to AI-related tools or intelligent service integration, and a desire to further develop technical expertise in modern engineering tools and methodologies.

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, and/or relevant professional certifications in software engineering or cloud technologies.

 **Disclaimer**  

This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ABOUT XACTLY**

Xactly is the global leader in AI-driven Sales Performance Orchestration. We help enterprise organizations align revenue strategy with execution — connecting planning, incentives, and performance in one Intelligent Revenue Platform. Trusted by industry leading companies worldwide, Xactly empowers sales teams to perform at their peak.

**THE OPPORTUNITY – Senior Software Engineer**

In this role, you will be part of a high-performing Engineering team that shapes the future of cloud-native enterprise platform architecture. You will collaborate across global teams, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to delivering high-impact, scalable software solutions for our enterprise customers.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Architect, design, and build scalable, high-performance microservices, RESTful APIs, and backend systems using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build, automate, and maintain end-to-end continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for microservices infrastructure.
* Design, optimize, and manage resilient data access layers using SQL databases (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL key-value stores.
* Drive engineering discipline and quality through rigorous code reviews, automated unit testing, continuous deployment, and adherence to software architecture standards.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product Management and global engineering teams to own features from concept and design to production deployment.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field with 8+ years of software development experience, OR Master’s degree with 5+ years of software development and web architecture experience.
* Solid, hands-on proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful web services, and MVC architectural patterns.
* Strong expertise in database development and SQL (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Demonstrated experience building end-to-end CI/CD and automated deployment pipelines for microservices.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and team collaboration skills, with a track record of applying strong engineering practices (unit testing, code reviews).

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building modular, scalable systems with technologies such as Scala, NoSQL data stores, Hadoop, or Apache Spark.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Chef, Puppet) and containerization technologies.
* Experience working in Agile (Scrum) environments within distributed, global engineering teams.
* Contributions to open-source projects or a track record of championing new engineering technologies.

**WHY XACTLY**

**BENEFITS AND PERKS**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Comprehensive Health and Accidental Insurance Coverage
* Tuition Reimbursement
* XactlyFit Gym/Fitness Program Reimbursement
* Free snacks onsite (if you work in office)
* Generous Employee Referral Program
* Free Parking and Subsidized Bus Pass (a go-green initiative!)
* Wellness program

**OUR VISION:** To power the revenue engine of the companies changing the world.

**OUR CORE VALUES:** Customer Focus | Accountability | Respect | Excellence (CARE) are the keys to our success, and each day we’re committed to upholding them by delivering the best we can to our customers.

Xactly is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Xactly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. This means we believe in celebrating diversity and creating an inclusive workplace environment, where everyone feels valued, heard, and has a sense of belonging. By doing this, everyone in the Xactly family has the power to make a difference and unleash their full potential.

We do not accept resumes from agencies, headhunters, or other suppliers who have not signed a formal agreement with us.

title: Developer II - Embedded Software
description:
**Role description**

Automotive Android Audio Framework Engineer Experience: 3–9 Years Domain: Automotive Infotainment Technology: Android Automotive / AOSP / Android Audio Framework Location: [Insert Location] Employment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for Automotive Android Audio Framework Engineers to join our Automotive Infotainment engineering team. The role involves development, customization, integration and debugging of the Android Audio Framework for production automotive infotainment systems. The engineer will work across the Android audio software stack, from Android Framework and Native Audio components through Audio HAL and underlying platform/DSP interfaces. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with AOSP Android Audio Framework, excellent C++ programming and system-level debugging skills, and preferably experience developing audio functionality for Automotive Infotainment / Android Automotive (AAOS) products. Key Responsibilities Develop, customize and maintain Android Audio Framework components for Automotive Infotainment systems. Work with AOSP source code and implement audio requirements at Framework and Native layers. Develop and debug functionality involving: AudioManager / AudioService AudioFlinger AudioPolicyService / AudioPolicyManager AudioTrack / AudioRecord Audio Focus Audio Routing Audio Attributes Audio Devices Audio HAL Analyze and resolve issues across: Application Android Audio Framework Native Audio Audio HAL DSP / Audio Hardware Implement and debug audio focus, routing, volume, ducking, muting and stream-priority requirements. Work with concurrent audio sources such as Media, Navigation, Voice Assistant, Phone/Call and System Sounds. Debug audio issues including no-audio, incorrect routing, audio interruptions, audio focus failures, audio dropouts/glitches, latency and volume-related issues. Analyze audio behavior during boot, shutdown, suspend/resume and power-state transitions. Work closely with Audio HAL, BSP/DSP and hardware teams to identify and resolve cross-layer issues. Perform detailed root-cause analysis using logs, traces and source-code analysis. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, integration and defect resolution. Develop and execute unit/integration tests for Audio Framework functionality. Support system integration, validation and production releases. Own issues from problem reproduction root-cause analysis implementation validation closure.

 **Skills**

Android Audio Framework, Android Automotive, Android AudioManager, C++, Android AudioRecord, Issue Analysis, Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Android AudioService, Android Audio Policy, Android AudioTrack

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

What You’ll Do

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications, combining responsive, accessible React interfaces with backend services and RESTful APIs.
* Build scalable backend services using Java/Spring Boot and Node.js/TypeScript, integrating SQL and NoSQL databases with high availability and fault tolerance.
* Optimize query performance and data modeling across **relational (SQL)** and **document/key-value (NoSQL)** stores.
* Use AI coding agents to plan and implement frontend and backend features, navigate repositories, refactor code, generate and run tests, and debug issues; review and validate changes for correctness, quality, and security.
* Implement secure coding practices leveraging **SAST** and **DAST** tools; partner with security to remediate findings.
* Build reusable UI components and backend integrations using shared libraries for authentication, configuration, logging, caching, and data access; collaborate on CI/CD, containerization, and runtime operations.
* Contribute to cloud-ready architecture; deploy and monitor frontend applications and backend services on cloud platforms such as Azure.
* Ensure code quality and collaboration using **GitHub** (PRs, code reviews, branching strategies).
* Troubleshoot frontend, API, and database issues in production, perform root cause analysis, and improve performance and reliability across the application.
* Own features from requirements and UI/API design through implementation, automated testing, and release; collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams in an Agile environment.

Key Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or a related field, or relevant experience considered.
* At least 5 years of software development experience, including hands-on delivery across frontend and backend.
* Strong proficiency in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, plus backend development experience with Java/Spring Boot or Node.js; willingness to work across both backend stacks.
* **Hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases**, including schema design, indexing, performance tuning, and transactions.
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and frontend-to-backend integration, including API contracts, validation, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Hands-on experience with AI agentic coding workflows: providing requirements and repository context, guiding multi-step implementation, using development tools and test feedback, and reviewing agent-generated changes. Ability to validate results while protecting sensitive data and respecting security, privacy, and licensing constraints.
* **Knowledge of SAST and DAST** for secure coding practices.
* **Familiarity with cloud platforms** such as **AWS**, **Azure**, or **Google Cloud**.
* **Experience with source control systems**, preferably **GitHub**.
* **Excellent communication skills** for effective collaboration across teams.
* **Demonstrated ability** to work efficiently in a team-oriented environment.
* **Capability to manage complex requirements** and adhere to deliverable timelines.
* **Experience or knowledge in DevOps practices** (CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure as code) is a valuable asset.

Preferred Experience

* Proficiency with SQL (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra), including data modeling and migration strategies; familiarity with Redis caching.
* Experience with **Docker** and **Kubernetes** for container orchestration.
* Familiarity with **observability** tooling (logging, metrics, tracing) and performance profiling.
* Knowledge of API gateways, service mesh, or message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ); experience with micro-frontends, shared component libraries, and design systems.
* Experience creating reusable instructions and workflows for AI coding agents, including test generation, static analysis, documentation, and safe refactoring; familiarity with MCP tools and schema validation.
* Understanding of **security best practices** (OAuth2/OpenID Connect, secrets management, TLS).

Nice-to-Have

* Experience with **infrastructure** concepts: networking, load balancing, autoscaling, and cost optimization.
* Exposure to **IaC** tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) and **pipeline automation** (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Background in frontend and backend test automation (unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing) and blue/green or canary deployments.
* Familiarity with **AI governance** practices, including prompt hygiene, data redaction, and validation against organizational coding standards.

title: AI/Software Engineer
description:
External Job Ad:

**AI Engineer / Software Engineer**

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**

Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.

**Job Summary**

In this role, you will design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions—LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows—integrated with enterprise data and systems. Working alongside senior engineers and in close collaboration with product, engineering, and security partners, you’ll help deliver reliable, scalable, and safe GenAI capabilities, with a focus on evaluation, observability, and cost/latency performance in production.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  

* Design and implement LLM-powered conversational experiences (chat assistants/AI Agents), integrating tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources

  

* Build and maintain RAG pipelines (document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing) using vector databases and AI-enabled search

  

* Develop LLM inference and orchestration components (prompt templates, function/tool calling, streaming, caching) that meet defined latency and reliability targets

  

* Implement safety and compliance guardrails (content filtering, prompt injection defenses, data access controls) and support red-teaming/testing of GenAI applications

  

* Help optimize GenAI solutions for cost and performance (token usage, prompt compression, caching, model routing) while maintaining response quality

  

* Apply Responsible AI practices for GenAI (grounding, hallucination mitigation, privacy-by-design, bias/toxicity evaluation) and align with security requirements

  

* Document designs, prompts, evaluation results, and operational runbooks; contribute reusable components and code that the wider team can build on

**What You'll Need to Succeed**
-------------------------------

* BE/BTech in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

3–5 years of total experience as a software engineer, including hands-on experience building and shipping AI/ML and GenAI solutions (LLMs, RAG, prompt/tool calling) using Python. Good to have: Node, React, Terraform, Git, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes

* Programming skills in Python and experience building LLM applications using common frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph); familiarity with evaluation/testing frameworks is a plus

  

* Hands-on experience deploying GenAI applications on cloud platforms (GCP/Azure/AWS), including integration with managed LLM services and secure API patterns

  

* Experience with vector databases and retrieval systems (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch); exposure to LLMOps tooling for prompt/version management and evaluation is a plus

  

* Working knowledge of CI/CD and familiarity with observability for GenAI systems (quality/safety metrics, tracing, monitoring latency and cost)

  

* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence); ability to clearly communicate technical work and trade-offs to the team

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to debug GenAI issues (grounding gaps, hallucinations, prompt injection, retrieval quality) across application, data, and infrastructure layers

**When You Join Team Applied, You Can Expect:**

**A culture that values who you are** and recognizes that you aren’t just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.

**We flex our time together**, collaborating remotely and in-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them.

**Learn more about the people behind our products at** –

* LinkedIn Page Applied Systems India
* https://www1.appliedsystems.com/en-us/about-us/jobs/

**Your Security Matters:**

Our candidates’ personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At Applied, we proactively protect your personal information and only communicate with candidates via a secure@appliedsystems.com email or through our official career’s portal.

**EEO Statement**

Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. At Applied, we don’t discriminate, and we are committed to recruit, develop, retain, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

title: Manager Software Engineering
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**JOB PURPOSE:**
  
The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

**JOB DUTIES:**

* The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
* Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
* The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
* Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
* Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
* Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
* Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
* Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
* Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.
* Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications.
* The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions.
* The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc.
* S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
* Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Basic Qualifications:**
  

* Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
* Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
* Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
* Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

**Top candidates will also have:**

* Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
* Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
* Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
    
  Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

**Proven experience in many of the following:**  

* Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
* Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
* Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
* Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
* Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
* Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
* Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
* Researching data to support design decisions.
* Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
* Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc

* Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot.
* Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis.
* Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks.
* Nice to Have – BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.

**Posting Dates:**

October 21, 2026 - October 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

* 10 plus years experience in SAP project delivery
* Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills

title: Software Engineer 3
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

As a Software Engineer at Lam, you will be at the forefront of innovation by designing, developing, and troubleshooting, and debugging software programs. Your role is pivotal in developing software tools that support design, infrastructure, and technology platforms. Your expertise will determine hardware compatibility and influence design, ensuring seamless integration between software and hardware.

In this role, you’ll make an impact across Lam’s entire product portfolio of equipment working within our centralized software engineering team, collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of LAM standards compliant software
* Plans, coordinates, and executes development activities within small to medium-sized projects
* Responsible for leading and driving projects involving multiple developers from within and other departments by taking complete ownership of component software
* Responsible for maintenance of install base by analyzing, debugging and fixing customer issues
* Participates in customer issues and escalations to provide quick workarounds and long-term fixes
* Responsible for technically reviewing and mentoring junior engineers with the object to deliver high quality software on time
* Interact with peers across teams to carry out day to day activities
* Initiates and drives continuous improvement projects aimed at improving productivity enabling business units deliver products with minimum cost and shortest cycle time
* Drives productivity of the group by monitoring and reporting KPIs and driving necessary actions to address any gaps
* Lead the identification, development, and responsible deployment of AI-enabled solutions for software engineering productivity, semiconductor equipment diagnostics by driving AI-assisted engineering practices, collaborating across software, process, hardware, field and support teams, and ensuring measurable quality, reliability and safe fallback behaviour

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in engineering preferably Computer Sc / Electronics / Information Technology Years of Experience – 5 to 8 years

**Mandatory Skills:**
---------------------

* Programming knowledge in C – preferably in hardware interfacing
* Knowledge of RTOS
* Experience in SDLC – Participated in design, IM and testing of projects
* Strong analytical, logical, trouble shooting skills
* Excellent problem solving and decision-making skills
* Hands on experience in complete project development life cycle
* Exposure to customer management
* Hands-on experience applying AI-assisted software engineering tools for code generation, code review, Unit test creation, defect analysis, and technical documentation, with strong validation and secure-use practices
* Ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled productivity solutions while protecting intellectual property, safety and regulatory compliance

**Desirable Skills:**

* Knowledge of OOPS concepts, Scripting
* Experience in the semiconductor equipment manufacturing industry
* Understanding of distributed systems and socket programming
* Excellent communication and Presentation skills
* Experience using equipment, sensor, alarm, trace, or log data for anomaly detection, predictive diagnostics, root-cause analysis, process monitoring, or maintenance optimization in semiconductor manufacturing systems
* Familiarity with generative AI patterns and agentic workflows for engineering knowledge retrieval.
* Exposure to deploying and monitoring AI solutions in production, including version control and lifecycle governance

**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Senior IT Analyst Applications
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Roles and Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand dealer order-planning, product-structure, interface, data, reporting, and operational-planning needs.
* Collect, analyze, document, and maintain business requirements, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and traceability for application changes.
* Assess enhancement requests and production issues, clarify business value and impact, and support backlog refinement with product and technical teams.
* Level 4 support for product incidents, service requests, data issues, and recurring defects; analyze application behavior, interfaces, logs, batch dependencies, and business impact to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate development requests with developers, database teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity partners, and vendors; validate that fixes address the documented business need.
* Manage enhancements and code fixes from demand intake through implementation, including scope clarification, test planning, business validation, release readiness, and post-production verification.
* Develop functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance test scenarios; coordinate test execution, document evidence, manage defects, and confirm solution quality.
* Create and maintain application support procedures, interface inventories, data mappings, knowledge articles, and business continuity or recovery instructions.
* Facilitate communication between business and technical teams by translating business needs into clear solution requirements and technical issues into understandable business impacts and options.
* Identify opportunities for product modernization, process simplification, automation, improved controls, stronger monitoring, and reduced manual support effort.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, testers, vendors, and business users throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, solution analysis, application support, product support, or technology delivery.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications and coordinating production incident, problem, change, and release activities.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate business-process, application, interface, and data issues.
* Experience developing test scenarios, coordinating user acceptance testing, managing defects, and validating production changes.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, interfaces, batch processing, and system integration or data-flow analysis.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and manage work across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong skills in accountability, organization, collaboration, customer focus, and managing priorities under time constraints.

**Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning, dealer demand or order planning, order management, product configuration, bill of materials, or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of S&OP business processes, data structures, batch cycles, interfaces, controls, and downstream dependencies.
* Familiarity with C#/.NET and Python applications sufficient to support requirement analysis, issue triage, testing, and collaboration with developers.
* Experience with Oracle, Snowflake, Windows Server, FTP or secure file transfer, load-balanced applications, and operational-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

**What You Will Have**

**Business Analysis:** Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.

**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.

**Application Delivery Process:** Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.

**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.

**Software Quality Management:** Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.

**Problem Management:** Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.

**Information Security Technologies:** Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.

**Stakeholder Management:** Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

**What You Will Get**

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

**Additional Information**

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.

Skill Descriptors  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

  
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

  
Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

  
System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

  
System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

  
Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Senior ABAP Developer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager

In this role, you will build and support the SAP ABAP solutions that run our business as one of the first developers on a new central development team. Each day, you will write production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA: reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms, and posting logic. You will work directly with the business users who depend on that code. You will also showcase your experience by taking on work across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales as priorities shift, and by bringing practical clean core judgment to our S/4HANA journey. You will learn and use the agentic AI development platforms the team is adopting, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct.

In this role, you will report to the ABAP Development Lead, work as an individual contributor, and have no people management responsibilities.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. #LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the ABAP Development Lead; functional consultants; the SAP BTP and integration teams; and SAP Basis.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
---------------------------------------

  

* Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC every week, closing your commitments on the date you gave, chasing what is blocked, and following up after go-live until the problem is really solved.
* Bridging to S/4HANA: contributing to S/4HANA Public Cloud stabilization and Private Cloud planning using CDS, RAP and ABAP Cloud, and choosing standard extensibility over classic enhancement where it fits.
* Working directly with the business: sitting with the people who have the problem, understanding the process and configuration behind it, and building what they actually need.
* Working to the team standard: following coding guidelines, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, reviewing colleagues' code, and using AI-assisted development within the team's rules.

**Our team dynamics**

You will become part of a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes and supports one another. AI is part of how we work, and we will help you get started if you are new to it. Done means it is being used by the business, not just transported, and a straightforward “I don’t know yet” is welcome.

**Qualifications for the role**

  

* You have more than 8 years of SAP development experience, with deep current ABAP knowledge in ECC, including enhancements, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, and REST interfaces, plus performance optimization.
* You show a consistent ability to deliver production outcomes that can be measured, including initiatives that were delayed before you inherited them.
* You have practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including CDS views and a solid understanding of clean core principles.
* You enjoy working directly with business users and understanding the process and configuration behind a requirement, not only the specification.
* You have established skills in working to a shared development standard, including code review, ABAP Test Cockpit, and transport discipline, in onshore/offshore or multi-team environments.
* You are open to AI-assisted development and ready to learn agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct. Prior AI experience.
* You are comfortable using English in both conversation and writing.

**What's in it for you?**

You will work on code that keeps a global business running and help shape how a new central team builds. You’ll have direct experience with the latest agentic AI tools for SAP development, along with guidance as you learn them. You can grow into a techno-functional or value stream role, or technical leadership, and we will support you on either path.

**More about us (Mandatory)**

At ABB, we help shape digital industries and power grids while supporting sustainable change in a wide range of sectors. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We cultivate a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+ identities, abilities, and generations, so every voice is heard.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform Engineering)
description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

This is a Principal position within the **Platform Engineering** organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated **Platform Engineering hat**, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience.

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our **Internal Developer Platform (IDP)**, fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering—working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams—while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization.

### **WHAT YOU BRING**

* **12+ Years** of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production.
* Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends.
* GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience—building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams.
* Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale—module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases.
* Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems.
* Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures.
* Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters.
* Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs.
* Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability.
* Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs.
* Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP).

### **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

### **Internal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal**

* Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning.
* Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles.
* Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails.
* Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach.

### **Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations**

* Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses.
* Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments.

### **Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes**

* Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users.
* Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams.
* Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level.
* Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations.

### **GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure**

* Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption.
* Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows.
* Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure.

### **API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure**

* Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives.
* Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths.

### **Infrastructure Automation & IaC**

* Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default.
* Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane).
* Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation.

### **Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience**

* Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics.
* Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths.
* Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants.
* Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements.

### **Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default**

* Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies.
* Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity.
* Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability.
* Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications.

### **Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure**

* Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service.
* Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP.

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

  

***Security & Compliance***  
This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training.  
  
***Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.***

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in the implementation and validation of DFT technologies.
* Experience with multiple projects in DFT design and verification, DFT specification, definition, architecture, and insertion.
* Experience with DFT techniques and tools, ASIC DFT synthesis, simulation, and verification flow.
* Experience in leading DFT activities throughout an ASIC development flow.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience in IP integration (e.g., memories, test controllers, Test Access Point (TAP), and DFT for Multi die SoCs).
* Experience in fault modeling.
* Experience in SoC cycles, silicon bringup, and silicon debug activities.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Design for Testing (DFT) micro-architect/design engineer, you will support the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will be part of a team that develops from the lowest levels of circuit design to large system design and sees those systems all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop DFT strategy and architecture (e.g., hierarchical DFT, DFT for high-speed I/Os, Analog DFT).
* Develop and drive die-level DFT validation strategy, complete all Test Design Rule Checks (TDRC), and execute design changes to fix TDRC violations to achieve high test quality.
* Insert DFT logic, boundary scan, scan chains, DFT Compression, Logic BIST, TAP controller, clock control block, and other DFT IP blocks.
* Document DFT architecture, test sequences, and boot-up sequences associated with test pins.
* Generate and deliver production and debug patterns to the post-silicon engineering team, and run diagnosis for post-silicon support.

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**  

The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, applications, and devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, highly collaborative teams with an entrepreneurial mindset within Microsoft.

The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises. Linux servers run highly business-critical workloads for our customers and are increasingly targeted by attackers seeking to disrupt those workloads. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to help protect Linux servers with high performance, quality, and innovative security capabilities. We are hiring a Group Engineering Manager for this product area. Our work provides peace of mind to customers by helping them protect their critical assets.

Our team includes people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work experiences, and life journeys, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. We are passionate about learning on the job, collaborating with other teams, and staying deeply focused on customer needs. Join us to build easy-to-use cybersecurity products that positively impact over a billion users from all walks of life.

  
**Responsibilities**

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead, mentor, and grow a talented and diverse team of engineers focused on delivering products that create deep customer value. You will partner with other Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional leaders to build a sustainable, high-performing team and foster an engineering culture focused on delivering products our customers love.

You will collaborate across teams to develop innovative solutions that protect Linux servers through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and contribute to the growth of the business. You will provide strong technical and people leadership, establish engineering rigor, foster a data- and results-driven culture, and build an environment of collaboration, inclusion, and trust.

You will also help drive the adoption and impact of Microsoft Security products while enabling your team to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.

If you are passionate about **Linux, cybersecurity, engineering excellence, and building high-performing teams**, this role offers an exciting opportunity to bring those passions together.

 **Qualifications**  

* **12+ years of experience in software engineering**, with experience building enterprise software and a proven track record of shipping commercially successful software products and services.
* Demonstrated ability to **lead, mentor, nurture, and grow engineering talent**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams comprising Software Engineers, Program Managers, Security Researchers, and Data Scientists.
* **3+ years of experience leading and building engineering teams**.
* **7+ years of experience designing and developing applications and systems on Linux**.
* **7+ years of experience applying software development principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices**.
* Strong understanding of **Linux internals** and experience building Linux-based products.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with **secure software development lifecycle (SDL) practices**.
* Experience with software development tools and systems, including source control systems such as Git, automated build systems, compilers, software validation systems, project tracking tools, and lifecycle management systems.
* Ability to work independently and drive complex **technical and architectural decisions and dependencies**.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience building **Linux kernel modules**.
* Contributions to **Linux open-source projects**, particularly in the kernel space.

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

title: ServiceNow Developer - ITSM
description:
**SERVICENOW DEVELOPER**  
  
**ABOUT DYSRUPIT**  
DysrupIT is a leading global-based cloud services company. We support clients across the globe  
in their adoption of the cloud and their transformation to as-a-Service business models. DysrupIT  
is dedicated to making a positive impact in the communities it serves.  
  
**COMPANY CULTURE**  
We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team. We offer a unique and  
extraordinary career experience to motivate and inspire talents like you to make a difference in  
our customers, clients, and the entire organization. At DysrupIT, you’ll join a team of dedicated  
and brilliant professionals who share the same goal of pursuing integrity and excellence. We are  
committed to promoting a culture where employees are valued and respected. We invest in our  
employees and make sure that they will have the right training to secure their growth and  
advancement towards their career aspirations.  
  
**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Application Developer is responsible for delivering ServiceNow enhancements, integrations, and  
backlog remediation aligned to the client's business priorities. The Developer will work closely with  
the Solution Architect and Business Analyst to design, build, and deploy scalable, AI-enabled  
ServiceNow solutions within a complex enterprise environment.  
  
**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**  

* Deliver ServiceNow enhancements, configurations, and backlog items aligned to sprint priorities

and business objectives.  

* Design and build custom REST API integrations with external systems in alignment with the

platform architecture.  

* Implement AI-enabled development practices and leverage the ServiceNow AI stack, including

Now Assist and Predictive Intelligence, to improve solution quality and efficiency.  

* Partner with the Solution Architect and stakeholders to design scalable, best-practice ServiceNow

solutions.  

* Apply automation principles to improve speed, quality, and delivery efficiency across the backlog.
* Support sprint execution, including development, peer review, testing, deployment preparation,

and continuous platform improvement.  

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and adherence to the Team Working

Agreement.  

* [Lead Developers] Provide technical guidance and code reviews for Senior Developers; serve as

a point of escalation for complex development challenges.  

* [Lead Developers] Take ownership of complex integrations and high-priority backlog items

requiring architectural alignment.  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* 6-9 years of ServiceNow development experience; Senior: 6–9 years.
* Strong hands-on development skills in ServiceNow, including Flow Designer, Business Rules,

Client Scripts, Script Includes, and REST API integrations.  

* Solid understanding of ITSM module configuration and platform governance principles.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery teams with Jira or similar tools.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled ServiceNow features (Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail in complex, customized environments.

  
**PREFERRED:**  

* Experience with both ITSM and CSM modules — preferred as the engagement may expand to

CSM in a future phase.  

* Prior exposure to large enterprise or regulated industry environments (healthcare, medical devices,

or similar).  

* ServiceNow micro-certifications or badges in AI, Now Assist, or automation features.
