title: Software Engineer - Python
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
**What you will do**  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
**Preferred skills and experience**  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.

The Senior Software Engineer role delivers scalable, secure, and maintainable software by solving complex problems and applying modern architectural patterns. Acting as a bridge across engineering, QA, and operations, it enforces secure coding, embeds observability, and fosters collaboration to ensure high‑quality, seamless product deliveries.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Training:**

Professional competencies

* Experience of collaborating in a cross functional and cross-cultural organisation, with the ability to support the bridge between the markets (sales) teams and the industry (vertical) teams.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. * Strong communication skills: ability to articulate the sharp questions, write clear requirements, review critically, and explain trade-offs

-------------------------------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. **Senior**
  
**Oracle CPQ Developer** to join our

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* **Product Catalog Ownership:** Ensure that the product catalog within Oracle CPQ is complete and up to date. Define product attributes and classifications that will be used in pricing rules.
* **Create Pricing Lists and Rules:** Define pricing lists and rules in Oracle CPQ including specifying conditions that trigger the application of pricing rules.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues related to Oracle CPQ, such as system errors, configuration problems, and integration issues. Work with Oracle Support to address system issues.
* **Rule Logic and Formulas:** Use Oracle CPQ's rule engine to implement pricing logic and formulas. Update configurator models and rules to support business requirement changes.
* **Discount Structures:** Set up discount structures to determine how discounts are applied based on Epsilon's overall pricing strategy, including discount levels and thresholds.
* **Ongoing Monitoring and Maintenance:** Continuously monitor pricing performance and gather feedback. Make adjustments and updates to pricing rules as business objectives and product offerings change. Support Oracle CPQ quarterly updates to ensure system stability.
* **System Deployment** - Responsible for deploying monthly code releases to the Production environment, outside of standard US working hours.
* **User Support** - Provide timely technical support to end-users and ensure minimal downtime. Collaborate with teams to implement patches, upgrades, and configurations.
* **Optimization** - Assist in database performance optimization and query tuning. Identify and recommend process improvements for Oracle systems. Stay up to date with Oracle product releases and patches to determine the impact to the business.
* **CPQ Architecture & Strategy Ownership:**  
  Own the end-to-end Oracle CPQ solution architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with long-term pricing, sales, and digital commerce strategies. Define and maintain CPQ technical roadmaps.
* **Stakeholder & Executive Partnership:**

* **Technical Governance & Best Practices:**  
  Establish and enforce CPQ development standards, design patterns, and coding best practices. Review and approve solution designs, rule logic, integrations, and release plans to ensure quality and consistency.

* **Mentorship & Team Development:**

* Proven experience in supporting Oracle systems and applications. Experience developing Oracle CPQ, integrations, and developing and implementing data migrations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the Oracle CPQ platform's core features.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies, as well as hands-on experience in CPQ capabilities.
* Experience with BMI Configuration, Bill of Material (BOM) and Big Machines Language (BML). Translate business requirements into the CPQ system configurations.
* Understanding of Oracle E-Business Suite or Cloud solutions. Experience with commerce flows within CPQ is highly desirable.
* Understanding of efficient business processes within Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) domain preferable.
* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills. Ability to analyze business processes and develop systems/programs to support and improve them.
* Knowledge and experience with the following languages: Oracle Database Administration, SQL, Java or C#, JavaScript, JQuery, XML/XSL, BML is preferred.
* Relevant experience with SFDC.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Good communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Certification in Oracle technologies (preferred but not mandatory).

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  
  
Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.

* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  
Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  
  
The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  
  
This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  
  
We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.  
Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.  
Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.  
Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.  
Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.  
Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.  
  
A day in the life  
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  
  
About the team  
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

**Job Title - Senior Software Engineer** **- VTS**

**About Pearson**

**[Insert from Talent Team]**

**About VTS**

VTS is Pearson’s Professional Assessments test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments across Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, and improved developer and operational practices.

**Summary**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation, optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Quality Engineering, and DevOps to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable solutions.

**Key responsibilities**

**Technical leadership (through** **expertise)**

* Lead design and implementation for complex software components, services, and platforms.
* Drive technical decision-making for major features and engineering initiatives.
* Influence software architecture, design patterns, and engineering standards within your domain.
* Lead technical design sessions and contribute to architectural discussions with Product Architects.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Participate in interviews to help assess and hire engineering talent.
* Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to stakeholders outside your immediate team.

**Software development**

* Design and deliver enterprise-scale, secure, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
* Evaluate design alternatives and recommend approaches balancing value, risk, performance, and maintainability.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for critical production issues.
* Identify and mitigate technical debt, performance bottlenecks, reliability concerns, and operational risk.

**Quality, delivery, and collaboration**

* Champion engineering best practices across testing, automation, deployment, observability, and security.
* Partner with Quality Engineering to advance quality-by-design and automation.
* Support release planning, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, technical estimation, and platform modernization.

**Required education and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of complex, distributed systems.
* Experience providing technical leadership and mentorship within Agile engineering teams.
* Experience designing and operating within cloud-native environments.

**Technology stack**

This is the current stack for the team you would join. Direct experience is preferred, and strong experience with comparable languages, frameworks, and toolsets will also be considered.

* Java
* Spring Boot
* Angular
* REST APIs
* Microsoft Azure
* Microservices Architecture
* AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code)

**Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities**

* Strong software design and system architecture skills.
* Experience building highly available and scalable enterprise applications.
* Cloud-based DevOps workflows, CI/CD, application security, observability, and performance engineering.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering capability.
* Familiarity with LLMs / ML concepts and practical use of AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering work, preferred.
* Experience supporting accessibility compliance and WCAG standards, preferred.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

**Success measures**

* Delivers complex technical solutions that support critical business objectives.
* Builds software with strong reliability, maintainability, scalability, security, and performance.
* Influences technical direction through sound engineering judgment and well-supported recommendations.
* Is sought out by other engineers for guidance on difficult technical problems.
* Improves the capability of the broader engineering team through mentorship.
* Contributes to hiring quality through active participation in the interview process.
* Communicates technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders outside engineering, building trust and alignment.
* Identifies and addresses technical risks before they impact delivery, operations, or customers.

**Leadership behaviors**

**Customer** **Centricity** Anticipates customer needs by designing solutions that improve reliability, usability, performance, and scalability.

**Raise the Performance** **Bar** Sets a high standard for engineering quality and continuously explores better tools, frameworks, and approaches.

**Exceptional Collaboration for** **Value** Builds strong technical partnerships and helps teams make better decisions through knowledge sharing and constructive challenge.

**Our Leaders** **Inspire** Leads through credibility, expertise, and mentorship, creating an environment where engineers grow and solve hard problems together.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Software Engineer, Kernel and Firmware, Silicon Engineering
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 1 year of experience in development, testing and deployment of consumer electronics/embedded systems.
* 1 year experience with embedded programming in C.
* Experience with embedded systems, kernel, Linux, Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) or firmware, device driver.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Foundation/experience in Electrical, Electronics or Computer streams with competencies in Embedded domain, data structures and algorithms, and software design.
* Experience working closely with hardware designers and reading schematics.
* Experience with ARM or other low-power System on a Chip (SoC) architectures, memory system, fabric, Linux kernel, device drivers etc.
* Experience with interface protocols (e.g., USB, SPI, I2C, UART, UFS, Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe)), power management, system integration, software stacks, drivers.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.  
  
We are a vertically integrated team spanning from hardware through applications.

As a Software Engineer, Kernel and Firmware, Silicon, you will work on hardware and software.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design a software that can ultimately delight our application developers, and that can let them make use of hardware accelerators seamlessly and in a timely manner.
* Implement and validate firmware and Linux drivers for optimal power consumption and performance.
* Design, development, and test embedded software drivers for the next generation of smart devices.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Mid Level Full-Stack .NET Developer

(Cloud Native Development)

Job Description

About Kroll

* Kroll is the global leader in risk management and technology-driven solutions, helping organizations navigate complexity, protect assets, and innovate with confidence. Our engineering teams build secure, scalable, and cloud-native platforms that power mission-critical operations worldwide. At Kroll, you’ll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex challenges, and be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

Job Brief

* We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer who is passionate about building high-quality, scalable applications using .NET Core, C#, Azure, and modern web technologies. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you will design, develop, and optimize applications across the stack, leveraging cloud-native architectures and AI-driven tools to boost productivity and code quality.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop applications using .NET 8, while maintaining and modernizing legacy .NET Framework systems.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliver robust, secure solutions.
* Build efficient, reusable, and reliable code following best practices for performance and maintainability.
* Work with ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework, NHibernate) for data access and persistence.
* Collaborate with analysts, designers, and stakeholders to enhance existing applications and develop new features.
* Integrate software components into fully functional systems, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Perform testing, debugging, and troubleshooting in real-world scenarios.
* Document and maintain software functionality, ensuring clarity and compliance with standards.
* Leverage AI/LLM-based tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve code reviews, and accelerate development workflows.
* Stay ahead of emerging technologies, continuously modernizing architecture and practices.
* Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, full-stack applications, from concept to production.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of hands-on experience as a .NET Developer or Full-Stack Engineer.
* Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core (including .NET 8 and above), and ASP.NET MVC.
* Experience maintaining and modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications.
* Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
* Hands-on experience with microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems.
* Practical knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including query optimization and schema design.
* Experience with ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework, NHibernate).
* Familiarity with Olive framework (good to have).
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Strong understanding of application security best practices (OAuth2, JWT, SAML).
* Experience leveraging cloud solutions in Azure or AWS.
* Proficiency in unit testing and automation frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest).
* Exposure to AI/LLM-based development tools for productivity and code quality improvements.
* Ability to troubleshoot performance issues, optimize code, and ensure scalability.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Information

* Job Title: Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer
* Work Environment: Hybrid with flexibility; occasional travel for team meetings or client workshops.
* Reporting Structure: Reports to the Senior Director of Software Engineering.

description:

Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. The Device OS team is central to creating these innovative devices, providing the core OS, platform, features, and components. description:

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a Software Engineer, you will work on developing ML compilers for the Tensor TPU to accelerate Generative AI and other complex machine learning models running on custom hardware accelerators. Along with your technical expertise, you will manage project priorities, deadlines and deliverables.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

--------------------

* Build compilers and tools that efficiently map ML models (with a particular focus on always-on computing use cases) to the hardware ISA.

description:

Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Battery Management Systems

Build production software that advances intelligent battery systems across markets

**Role Overview**
=================

Analog Devices Inc. (ADI) is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with four to six years of experience to build and productize software across the complete Battery Management Systems (BMS) stack. You will work from MCU platforms and BMS IC device drivers through battery-algorithm implementation and integration, creating scalable solutions for automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging markets.

This role offers broad technical ownership and the opportunity to solve demanding hardware–software and algorithm-integration problems. You will combine strong Embedded C and Python skills with mathematics, electrical engineering, and systems thinking to deliver efficient, production-quality software for resource-constrained real-time platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Build the complete BMS software stack** , including MCU platform software, hardware abstraction, diagnostics, BMS IC and peripheral device drivers, communication, monitoring, protection, and balancing.
* **Deploy battery algorithms on embedded targets** , translating models and reference code for SOC, SOH, power capability, diagnostics, anomaly detection, and impedance-based functions into deterministic Embedded C.
* **Optimize for real-world constraints** , including execution time, memory, power, numerical accuracy, scaling, and fixed- or floating-point behavior.
* **Scale software across products and markets** through reusable architectures and configurable solutions for multiple MCUs, BMS ICs, toolchains, battery topologies, and operating environments.
* **Create robust Python engineering tools** for automated testing, data processing, visualization, calibration, profiling, and algorithm validation.
* **Own delivery from concept to release** , driving requirements, design, implementation, verification, troubleshooting, reviews, and maintenance in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* B.E. / B.Tech or M.E. / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of embedded software experience in BMS, battery monitoring, power electronics, automotive, energy, industrial, or another safety- and reliability-focused domain.
* Proven delivery of embedded features from requirements and design through integration, verification, and release.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* **Embedded C and Python:** Strong programming skills and the ability to independently develop production embedded software and maintainable tools for automation, testing, data analysis, visualization, and algorithm validation.
* **Embedded systems:** Strong knowledge of MCU architecture, interrupts, timers, memory, DMA, peripherals, boot flow, RTOS or bare-metal systems, communication protocols, build systems, debugging, version control, and continuous integration.
* **BMS and electrical engineering:** Understanding of battery cells and packs, sensing, ADCs, isolation, contactors, protection, balancing, diagnostics, filtering, signal integrity, and basic controls; ability to interpret schematics, data sheets, and timing diagrams.
* **Mathematics and algorithms:** Strong quantitative foundation in calculus, probability, statistics, numerical methods, linear systems, and signal processing, with practical understanding of precision, scaling, overflow, error, and computational complexity.
* **Engineering quality:** Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, supported by disciplined requirements, design, review, configuration management, testing, traceability, and defect management practices.

**Behavioral Expectations – Senior Engineer**
---------------------------------------------

* Take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality results.
* Use structured, data-driven thinking to solve complex and ambiguous problems.
* Collaborate effectively and communicate decisions, risks, and results clearly.
* Adapt, share knowledge, support colleagues, and continuously improve.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with SOC, SOH, state-of-power, impedance, estimation, prediction, or diagnostic algorithms.
* Exposure to MATLAB/Simulink, model-based development, code generation, calibration, or algorithm prototyping.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, functional safety, cybersecurity, Automotive SPICE, MISRA C, static analysis, performance optimization, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or data-driven battery analytics.

**Why Join ADI?**
-----------------

* **Own meaningful technical challenges** across the full BMS software stack and product lifecycle.
* **Build solutions with market impact** across automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging applications.
* **Grow with a strong engineering community** that values technical depth, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Do you want to build secure, scalable cloud controls that protect a large Azure-managed environment while enabling customer-facing teams to move quickly?

The Azure Managed Environment team provides governed Azure tenants and subscriptions for customer demonstrations, proofs of concept, support engineering, and other non-production scenarios. The service applies centralized policy, monitoring, automated remediation, lifecycle governance, and cost controls to reduce production-tenant exposure, limit shadow IT, and preserve delivery agility.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate automated control solutions that enforce security and governance requirements across this environment. You will translate SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and business requirements into scalable policies, automations, telemetry, and remediation workflows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines software engineering, cloud security, operational judgment, and cross-functional leadership. You will partner with security architects, service owners, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve control effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the resilience of the managed environment.

  
**Responsibilities**

* Engineer cloud controls: Design and develop reusable Azure Policy definitions, policy initiatives, automation, and remediation workflows that enforce security and governance requirements across managed tenants and subscriptions.
* Lead control implementation: Assess new SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and internal control requirements; determine affected resources and control gaps; and lead architecture, implementation, validation, and rollout.
* Build compliance by design: Embed secure defaults, configuration standards, monitoring, and automated remediation into provisioning and lifecycle processes so compliance is consistent and scalable.
* Own engineering quality: Establish design standards, code-review practices, testing, release controls, documentation, and operational readiness for cloud-control solutions.
* Improve detection and remediation: Use telemetry, execution logs, and control-effectiveness measures to identify failures, tune enforcement, reduce false positives, and accelerate risk reduction.
* Advance lifecycle and cost governance: Engineer solutions for tenant and subscription provisioning, renewal, decommissioning, ownership hygiene, resource governance, allowance management, and cost optimization.
* Automate repeatable operations: Replace manual processes and one-off scripts with durable services, APIs, pipelines, and AI-enabled engineering approaches where appropriate.
* Support operational resilience: Provide engineering leadership during complex incidents and escalations, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Partner across functions: Work with service owners, security and privacy teams, platform engineering, finance, support, and business stakeholders to align requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers, communicate design and risk tradeoffs clearly, and influence decisions without relying on direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience using one or more general-purpose languages, scripting languages, or infrastructure-as-code technologies; OR a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 1+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-quality cloud services, automation, or platform engineering solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Policy, Azure Resource Manager, identity and access management, monitoring, or subscription and tenant governance.
* Understanding of secure software development, cloud security controls, least privilege, configuration management, and automated compliance.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues, use telemetry to drive decisions, and lead remediation across multiple teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and risk tradeoffs to engineering and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C#, Python, PowerShell, TypeScript, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps or GitHub pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building Azure Policy definitions and initiatives, policy-as-code solutions, automated remediation, compliance dashboards, or control-evidence pipelines.
* Knowledge of Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, Entra ID, role-based access control, resource lifecycle management, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience operating services at enterprise scale, including incident response, root-cause analysis, health service monitoring, and reliability improvement.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to engineering productivity, operations, detection, or remediation.
* Relevant Azure, security, DevOps, or cloud architecture certification.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

description:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Principal Storage Software Engineer – Cloud & Distributed Storage**
=====================================================================

**About the Role**
------------------

* We are looking for a highly experienced Storage Software Engineer with 15+ years of software engineering experience to architect, design, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms and database-aware storage platforms running in Kubernetes environments.
* This role is ideal for a senior technical leader who can architect, design, code, influence, and own complex storage systems end-to-end. You will play a key role in defining the technical direction and evolution of our storage platform while driving engineering excellence and raising the technical bar across the organization.
* This is a deeply hands-on engineering role that combines strong systems programming and coding skills with storage architecture, distributed systems expertise, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defining long-term architecture, writing production-quality code, solving complex performance and reliability problems, and guiding engineers through the design and delivery of large-scale storage systems.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Architect and develop highly scalable block, file, and object storage systems.
* Build database-aware storage optimized for PostgreSQL, relational databases, distributed databases, and other stateful workloads.
* Use AI coding agents to your advantage to boost productivity and lead us to the future of AI native engineering. Capable of giving the right context and detailed requirements to the Agent.
* Design storage data planes and control planes for Kubernetes environments.
* Develop Kubernetes-native storage integrations using CSI, operators, controllers, CRDs, and storage classes.
* Write production-quality systems software in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Design for high availability, data durability, fault tolerance, replication, recovery, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery.
* Optimize storage for IOPS, throughput, latency, tail latency, CPU efficiency, and network utilization.
* Debug complex problems across databases, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and storage layers.
* Lead architecture and design reviews and establish technical direction for storage platforms.
* Mentor engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture, design, coding, and troubleshooting.
* Be responsible for the outcome of the domain’s work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering.
* 15-18 years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in storage, distributed systems, databases, or infrastructure software.
* Deep knowledge of storage domains: block, file, object, or database storage.
* Strong systems programming skills in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Strong understanding of Linux storage and I/O architecture.
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.
* Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure experience.
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts including replication, consensus, consistency, failure detection, data placement, and recovery.
* Experience with storage technologies and protocols such as NVMe, NVMe-oF, SCSI/iSCSI, UBD, S3, CSI, io\_uring, SPDK, or similar technologies.
* Ability to lead technically while remaining a hands-on engineer who designs, codes, reviews, benchmarks, and debugs production systems.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

As a Principal Engineer, you will help define the long-term technical direction for our storage platform. You will work across storage, database, Kubernetes, networking, hardware, and infrastructure engineering teams to build reliable, high-performance storage services for business-critical workloads.

We are looking for an engineer who can operate from architecture to code to production—someone who can design the system, build critical components, analyze performance, diagnose difficult failures, and lead other engineers in delivering storage infrastructure at scale.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**About the Team**
------------------

Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Set the direction:**

* Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.
* Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community
* Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.
* Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.
* Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.
* Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.

**Own the Platform:**

* Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.
* Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.
* Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.
* Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions
* Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title.
* Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several.
* Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling.
* A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages.
* Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority.

**Nice to have**

* Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects.
* Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks.
* Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting.
* Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation.
* Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC.

title: Software Engineer - Model API Platform
description:
**About Sarvam**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC.

**About the role**

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.

**What you will do**

**Own a platform area end to end**

* Own one or more major parts of the platform, such as the WebSocket streaming layer, a speech recognition pipeline, or text to speech pipeline: build, operate and improve them.
* Turn loosely defined goals into RFCs, milestones and shipped results, and write down the decisions and trade-offs.
* Be accountable after launch: on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through on fixes.
* Make the call when a decision is needed, and own the outcome.
* Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.
* Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.

**Build real-time and model-serving pipelines**

* Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.
* Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.
* Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.

**Think in systems and from first principles**

* Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.
* Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.
* Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.
* Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing that let anyone debug production quickly.

**Raise the bar for the team**

* Strengthen the integration testing harness so the team can ship fast without breaking customer-facing APIs.
* Partner with the Inference and MLOps teams on making model serving fast, reliable and operable.
* Mentor junior engineers through RFC reviews, code review and pairing.
* Practice design-first, documentation-first engineering: RFCs before code, no tribal knowledge.

**What we are looking for**

* 4–6 years of building and operating production backend systems.
* At least one service you owned end to end under real load, including what broke and what you changed.
* Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, queues, caching, consistency and failure modes.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput services, and comfort reasoning about p95 and p99 latency.
* Solid fundamentals with a relational database and a cache, such as PostgreSQL and Redis: schema design, query performance and caching strategy.
* Fluency in at least one backend language and willingness to work in both Python and Golang.
* Experience running services with containers, CI/CD and production monitoring.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, with concrete examples of what you automated or sped up.
* A bias for action: fast on reversible decisions, careful on irreversible ones.
* Clear writing, especially RFCs and design docs that others can act on.

**Good to have (not required)**

* Voice AI or real-time audio experience: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming ASR or TTS, or audio processing with FFmpeg or pyav, codecs, sample rates and VAD.
* Production experience in Go, or in Python with FastAPI.
* Experience serving LLM, ASR, TTS or vision models in production.
* Experience building metering, billing, wallet or payments infrastructure.
* Running services on Kubernetes in production.
* Time at an early- or growth-stage startup.

**Why Sarvam**

* A fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, with real population-scale impact.
* Researchers, engineers, builders and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.
* High ownership and high impact from day one.
* AI-first in everything, from how we build and ship to how we think about problems

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

People & Work Intelligence (PWI) is building the intelligence layer that helps Microsoft 365 understand the work people do, the skills they possess, and how AI can accelerate workforce transformation. Our platform powers experiences across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Workforce Intelligence, Learning, Skills, Tasks, and organizational insights, enabling AI-driven decision making for individuals, managers, and enterprise leaders.

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to help build and evolve PWI’s intelligence, inferencing, platform, and AI-powered systems.

This role is ideal for a solid, hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, building reliable distributed systems, and applying modern AI technologies to real-world product scenarios. You will work on systems that process signals from Microsoft 365, generate meaningful intelligence, and power experiences across Copilot and People & Work Intelligence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own significant components and technical areas from design through production. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product management, data science, research, and partner teams to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.

Success in this role requires solid engineering fundamentals, experience building production services, sound technical judgment, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. You will also contribute to engineering quality, mentor other engineers, participate in design reviews, and help the team adopt modern AI-first engineering practices.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and operate scalable services and platform components for People & Work Intelligence.
* Own the design and implementation of distributed systems supporting skills intelligence, work intelligence, inferencing, analytics, and Copilot experiences.
* Build AI-powered solutions using technologies such as LLMs, retrieval systems, agent frameworks, knowledge graphs, and intelligence pipelines.
* Develop systems for signal processing, enrichment, contextual intelligence, recommendations, and enterprise-scale insight generation.
* Work closely with product managers, data scientists, researchers, and engineers to translate customer and product requirements into well-designed technical solutions.
* Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions, including API design, data models, scalability, reliability, security, privacy, and operational considerations.
* Drive engineering projects involving platform modernization, reliability, performance optimization, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Apply solid engineering practices across observability, testing, deployment automation, monitoring, incident prevention, and service health.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews and help improve engineering quality across the team.
* Mentor and support other engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, code reviews, debugging, and collaborative problem solving.
* Take ownership of ambiguous engineering problems, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and drive solutions from initial design through production rollout.
* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, improve developer productivity, and appropriately apply AI-assisted engineering.
* Collaborate effectively with partner teams across Microsoft to deliver end-to-end capabilities that power Microsoft 365 experiences.
* Contribute to a culture of customer focus, engineering excellence, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building and operating production software systems.
* Solid programming experience with C#, Java, Python, or comparable modern programming languages.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles, API design, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and building cloud-based services, APIs, platform components, or data-intensive systems.
* Experience delivering reliable production systems with consideration for scalability, performance, availability, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Experience with or solid interest in AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, RAG, agent frameworks, retrieval systems, or other intelligent systems.

### **About Okta**

Okta is an enterprise grade identity management service, built from the ground up in the cloud and delivered with an unwavering focus on customer success. With Okta you can manage access across any application, person, or device. Whether the people are employees, partners, or customers, or the applications are in the cloud, on premises, or on a mobile device, Okta helps you become more secure, make people more productive, and maintain compliance.

The Okta service provides directory services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, workflow, and built in reporting. It runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform and integrates deeply with on premises applications, directories, and identity management systems.

### **About the Team**

The Data Platform team is responsible for the foundational data services, systems, and data products for Okta that benefit our users. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables:

* Streaming analytics
* Interactive end-user reporting
* Data and ML platform for Okta to scale
* Telemetry of our products and data

Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever.

### **About the Position**

This is an opportunity for experienced Software Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low-latency, distributed data-platform services & data products. In this role, you will get to work with engineers throughout the organization to build foundational infrastructure that allows Okta to scale for years to come. As a member of the Data Platform team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying the systems that power our data analytics and ML. Our analytics infrastructure stack sits on top of many modern technologies, including Kinesis, Flink, ElasticSearch, and Snowflake.

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers who can help design and own the building, deploying and optimizing the streaming infrastructure. This project has a directive from engineering leadership to make OKTA a leader in the use of data and machine learning to improve end-user security and to expand that core-competency across the rest of engineering. You will have a sizable impact on the direction, design & implementation of the solutions to these problems.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement and own data-intensive, high-performance, scalable platform components
* Work with engineering teams, architects and cross functional partners on the development of projects, design, and implementation
* Conduct and participate in design reviews, code reviews, analysis, and performance tuning
* Coach and mentor engineers to help scale up the engineering organization
* Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack

  

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* 4+ years of experience of software development

* Proficient in at least one language while comfortable in more than one of the backend languages, preferably Java or Typescript, Ruby, GoLang, Python.
* Have experience working with at least one of the database technologies - MySQL, Redis, or PostgreSQL.
* Demonstrable knowledge of computer science fundamentals with strong API Design skills.
* Comfortable working on a geographically distributed extended team. Brings the right attitude to the team: ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Track record of delivering work incrementally to get feedback and iterating over solutions.
* Comfortable in React or similar front-end UI stacks; if not comfortable yet, you are willing to learn

### **Nice to have**

* Experience using a cloud-based distributed computing technologies such as
* + Messaging systems such as Kinesis, Kafka
  + Data processing systems like Flink, Spark, Beam
  + Storage & Compute systems such as Snowflake, Hadoop
  + Coordinators and schedulers like the ones in Kubernetes, Hadoop, Mesos
* Maintained security, encryption, identity management, or authentication infrastructure
* Leveraged major public cloud providers to build mission-critical, high volume services
* Hands-on experience in developing Data Integration applications for large scale (petabyte scale) environments with experience in both batch and online systems.
* Contributed to the development of distributed systems or used one or more at high volume or criticality such as Kafka or Hadoop

title: Lead Software Engineer - FinOps, Cloud Platform
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

At Chase International Consumer Bank, we are building a digital bank from the ground up, combining the agility of a modern engineering organization with the scale of a trusted global brand. As a Lead Software Engineer \- FinOps (Vice President) within JPMorganChase International Consumer Bank, you will be a hands\-on engineering leader helping Chase UK build and run cloud\-native capabilities that improve unit economics, reliability, and platform eMiciency across our public cloud footprint, primarily AWS.




You will design and deliver engineering solutions that make cloud financial management actionable through software, automation, and policy\-as\-code guardrails. You will partner closely with application, platform, and SRE/DevOps teams to influence architecture and delivery practices, and to embed strong engineering standards into day\-to\-day workflows.




You will operate in a modern cloud stack (AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, event\-driven components) and drive improvements across Kubernetes engineering, automation runbooks, and developer experience. Go is the primary language for application development in this role, with Python as a valuable secondary skill for tooling and automation. Good\-to\-have platform tooling includes GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and control\-plane automation approaches like Crossplane, as well as strong AWS solutions architecture depth.




**Job responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain backend services and automation in the cloud financial management space. The software you deliver will support cost tracking, allocation, governance, compliance, and reporting for teams running workloads on AWS (primary) and GCP (secondary).
* Deliver production\-grade software with strong engineering discipline, including clear design, code reviews, secure coding practices, and appropriate automated testing.
* Apply solid Kubernetes fundamentals to build practical solutions and standards, including resource requests and limits, scaling behaviour, workload placement, and safe operation of shared clusters.
* Create dashboards and engineering\-facing views that connect usage, performance, and scaling Behaviour to cost outcomes, and help teams act on the results.
* Build Kubernetes automation that improves eMiciency and reduces waste using proven tools and patterns such as Karpenter for node provisioning and right\-sizing, and KEDA for event\-driven scaling, along with custom automation where needed.
* Contribute to platform management and platform development practices, including cluster lifecycle and upgrades, platform reliability, standard templates, paved paths, and developer self\-service capabilities.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for services and platform components to enable repeatable, low\-risk releases, with strong visibility and rollback practices.
* Work closely with application teams, SRE/DevOps, and leadership to drive adoption of eMicient cloud patterns, and to ensure improvements are delivered and sustained in production.
* Bring strong cloud financial management knowledge to daily engineering work, including cost allocation and tagging hygiene, anomaly investigation, budget and forecast inputs, and measurement of realized impact.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Strong hands\-on software engineering experience building and operating backend services in production, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Go as the primary language for application development; Python is a strong for tooling, scripting, and automation.
* Strong Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience running workloads on Kubernetes (ideally EKS), including debugging, scaling, performance tuning, and safe operation of shared clusters.
* Strong knowledge of cloud financial management and cost governance on AWS, including cost allocation, tagging strategy, anomaly investigation, budgeting and forecasting inputs, and measuring realized savings.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS cost optimization levers beyond discount programs, including right\-sizing, scaling strategies, storage lifecycle choices, and architecture decisions that improve unit economics.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and control\-plane automation, including Terraform and Crossplane.
* Working knowledge of AWS networking and distributed systems fundamentals needed to build scalable and cost\-aware systems.
* Strong DevOps and SDLC practices, including code reviews, test automation, secure coding practices, and operational ownership.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for services and platform components, including GitHub Actions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills; comfortable working with cost and usage datasets to spot trends and drive practical engineering changes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to partner eMectively across platform, application, and operations teams to drive changes through to production




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience with Kubernetes eMiciency and scaling tooling such as Karpenter and KEDA.
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud cost visibility and optimization tools such as Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), AWS Compute Optimizer, and CloudWatch.
* Familiarity with broader cost governance and observability tooling (for example Grafana, QuickSight, Flexera) and the ability to turn data into actionable engineering work.
* GitOps and deployment tooling exposure such as Argo CD.
* Exposure to GCP billing and cost management concepts in addition to AWS
